name: copilot-migration-extension
description: AI-guided migration family for GitHub Copilot Chat: Upgrade · Rewrite · Replatform as the @migration Chat participant. Standalone — no Claude Code subscription required.

chatParticipants.name: migration
chatParticipants.description: AI-guided migration family: upgrade, rewrite, replatform.

commands.name: rewrite
commands.description: Out-of-place generative stack translation (e.g. Angular → React)

commands.name: replatform
commands.description: Hosting/topology migration — on-prem to cloud (IaC authored, human executes)

migration.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: Anthropic API key for judge-gate escalation (Upgrade · Rewrite · Replatform). When absent, the participant falls back to the active Copilot model. HIGH-risk gates display a WARN banner without this key.

migration.judgeModel.markdownDescription: Anthropic model used for critic/judge gates when `migration.anthropicApiKey` is set.

migration.copilotFamilyFallback.markdownDescription: Copilot model family used when Anthropic key is absent.
